sophie: postmortem follow-up: capture owners for rollout hardening (opt-outs, auto-rollback, blast-radius). keeping short.
anya: i can own emergency opt-out + runtime fallback (safe-model pool). target 2026-04-01.
mike: i'll take auto-rollback controller + unit/canary tests. rules: error_rate >1.5% (3m) OR p95 >1.8s (2m). aim 2026-04-03.
jamal: i'll own console caps UX + audit events (default 5% for 15m). ETA 2026-04-07.
sophie: add KV warmup gate for large-KV models: require prefix-cache-hit >=70% before ramp. anya + mike to implement.
anya: noted. runtime fallback should be env var + console toggle + traffic-steer to safe model.
mike: adding KV gate to controller and a manual override that requires SRE approval. will include tests.
jamal: make emergency opt-out visible to oncall by default, hide advanced controls behind perms.
oncall-bot: Reminder created: "Rollout hardening sync" weekly Mon 10:00 starting 2026-03-30. Attendees: eng-platform, eng-runtime.
sophie: short action list: 1) emergency opt-out -> anya -> 2026-04-01; 2) auto-rollback + tests -> mike -> 2026-04-03; 3) console caps + audit -> jamal -> 2026-04-07; 4) KV gate & telemetry -> anya+mike -> 2026-04-03. i'll update the postmortem doc and tracker. reply if missing. :white_check_mark:
